## 5. Routine
- Before the session: check economic calendar, earnings dates, levels on watchlist.
- During: only take trades that match a setup. Set stop and target immediately.
- After: journal every trade within the hour.

## 6. Emotional rules
- After 2 losses in a row I stop for the day.
- I never move a stop further away.
- I never add to a losing position.
